public_semantic_boundary.arithmetic_schedule: FMA(i0,k0,bias); separate-rounded MUL(i1,k1); FMA(i2,k2,acc0); ADD(acc0,product1); propagating MAX lower then MIN upper
public_semantic_boundary.memory_domain: Signed full-int64 pointer-table stride; full uint64 offsets/advances; zero sentinel skips offset; repeated/overlapping read-only rows and weights/params/zero share one RO map; output functional map permits repeated/overlapping pixel writes, last write wins; ordinary valid owned float/pointer cells, no implicit alignment stronger than model validity
